product.title: BOW Business Strategy Simulator — CandleCart.com
product.summary: Run an online candle store across five months, with a knowledge gate between each.
product.whatStudentsDo: Students choose a launch plan that sets demand and marginal cost, then run each month against randomised demand — ordering inventory, setting ad spend and price, absorbing a progressive tax in month five — and must pass a five-question check before the next month opens.

facilitation.prep: Apps Script must be bound to a copy of the workbook. The bound sheet is not in the repo.

studentDataProfile.notes: The Apps Script build writes to a StudentData sheet and identifies the student by Google account or a typed email, and emails a claim code. The browser build of the same experience stores nothing. Descriptive only.

governance.maturityBasis: 2,211 lines implementing all five chapters, checks and email delivery. Cannot be launched from the repo alone.

health.technicalBasis: No GitHub Pages deployment (404). Not verifiable without the bound Google Sheet.
knownBlockers: The bound Google Sheet is not in the repository.

governance.notes: Its own header states Grades 8–10, which sits outside the Track 201 convention of Grades 7–8. Recorded as stated rather than reconciled.

provenance.evidence: 201-M1-ECON/apps script header: 'BOW BUSINESS STRATEGY SIMULATOR v5.0 — Online Candle Store: CandleCart.com · Grades 8–10'. Collects student email and name via ui.prompt and emails a claim code from a CLAIM_CODES array.
